purpose: Cross-engine semantic sanity check on three formerly reproduced Spark wrong-result cases; not SQLancer, not an unseen blind test
fixtures: manual mirroring of the already frozen Spark Parquet fixture rows, registered as in-memory DuckDB SQL tables
adapter: Only replace Spark range(...) table-function column naming via alias AS __queryproof_range(id), preserving rows and expressions; no semantic query rewrites or corrections allowed
independent_sql_oracle: After execution compare DuckDB result bag to the original frozen expected answers and to Spark official observed rows from separate benchmark; predeclared missing results are failures not silently skipped
report: cross-engine agreement/disagreement per historical case, existing Spark incorrectness; no scientific novelty claim
negative_controls: all N01 N02 N03 must match original expected answers; no DuckDB engine errors
limitations: cross-engine SQL semantics may differ in general; verify this small shared SQL subset
no original SQLancer DQP or CODDTest implementation executed
